ios.desc:
Svegliare is the alarm clock for people who actually need to get up. Solve a mission to turn it off, and it keeps coming back until you do.

On iOS 26 and later, Svegliare uses Apple's alarm system, so it rings loudly even when your iPhone is on Silent or in a Focus.

WAKE UP FOR REAL
• Puzzle & mission alarms: math, tap, shake, steps and more
• Chain several missions in one alarm (Premium)
• Ring guard: close the app or swipe the alert away and the alarm rings again until the mission is done
• Loud, gradual or extreme sounds, music, or your own recorded voice

ALARMS FOR EVERY LIFE
• Repeat – daily routines for work, school and the gym
• Pattern – rotating shifts for nurses, security staff and anyone off a 9-to-5
• Timezone – set the time where you'll be; Svegliare converts it
• Destination – a GPS alert when you near your stop on a train, bus or flight
• Medication – dose times for pills and supplements
• Never Forget – a reminder when you leave a place without something important
• Quick, Single and Bunch alarms, Dream Journal, widgets, Light and Dark themes, iPhone and iPad

FREE & PREMIUM
Basic alarms plus Math (Easy/Medium) and Tap missions are free. Premium unlocks every mission type, Hard and Random, and multiple missions per alarm. Choose a subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. Prices vary by region. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in your Apple ID settings.

Privacy Policy: https://appreator.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://appreator.com/terms-of-use/
